note: Six queries for hands-on H1. Participants are not told which ones fail.

queries.text: I am the primary caregiver and I work in the Amsterdam office. How many working days of parental leave do I get?
queries.ground_truth: 130 working days / 26 weeks, primary caregiver, Amsterdam office (HB-PAR-2024 v4)

queries.text: How many weeks of paid parental leave do new parents get?
queries.ground_truth: Depends on the contracting office. HB-PAR-2024 v4 supersedes the global 12-week figure in HB-PAR-2022.

queries.text: What is the notice period if I resign from the Dublin office after three years?
queries.ground_truth: 6 weeks (Dublin, 2 to 5 years' service, HB-EXIT v3)

queries.text: What is the salary band for a senior engineer?
queries.ground_truth: The employee is not entitled to see HB-COMP-BANDS. Correct behaviour is to refuse and route to HR.

queries.text: How many days of annual leave do I get each year?
Can I claim a laptop stand on the home office allowance?
queries.ground_truth: Yes, within the one-off 600 EUR allowance (HB-EXP-HOME v2)
